title: nixos/frp: support multiple instances
reason: Real, large restructuring: single-instance enable/role/settings converted to a new instances.<name>.{enable,role,settings} wildcard attrsOf(submodule), with mkRenamedOptionModule shims for the old flat paths using an empty-string instance key (['services','frp','instances','','role'], etc). Same frp.nix file already flagged in an earlier batch for the wildcard environmentFiles gap.
targets_toml: Self-corrected: initial watch attempts used a literal empty-string array entry (watch = ['']) mirroring the module's own mkRenamedOptionModule empty-key convention -- oba's TOML parser REJECTS this outright ('TOOL_ERROR: invalid targets manifest: target 386406: watch contains an empty entry'), not a silent gap. Corrected to option_prefix=[services,frp,instances], watch=[role] (a real field name, not an instance key).

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: Real new nested-under-wildcard option, correctly not-found at base (old flat 'services.frp.role' path doesn't match the new nested query), discoverable at head (4 discovered_options) but untested -- expected, not a gap. Another same-shape-but-working wildcard attrsOf(submodule) instance this batch, alongside fedimintd's 'instances' and drupal's 'sites'.

candidate_rendering_gap: raw.json summary is correct (changed:1, correct oba_verdict_transitions) but rendered summary.md shows all New findings/Resolved/etc = 0 with no notable entries -- specific to *_not_found <-> *_not_found (and now also PredicateNotFound<->TestValueUnresolved / TestConfigUnresolved) style transitions where neither side has witnessed evidence.
